digests.title: TLDR Daily Digest
digests.tagline: AI, IT, Web Dev, InfoSec, DevOps, Design, Data

stories.headline: AI Agents Outwork Employees 6-to-1 at Anthropic
stories.blurb: An internal Anthropic study revealed that interactive AI agent work hours exceeded employee hours sixfold, driving major productivity gains but reducing entry-level technical hiring from 27% down to 9%.

stories.headline: DeepSeek Unveils V4.1 Flash Model
stories.blurb: DeepSeek released V4.1-Flash-1017, leveraging FP4 KV caching and Compressed Sparse Attention 2 to drastically shrink memory footprints while pushing the performance frontier on coding and agent benchmarks.

stories.headline: Microsoft Plans $2B Annual Deal for Anthropic Models
stories.blurb: Microsoft is reportedly preparing to spend over $2 billion per year integrating Anthropic's Claude models into Copilot to improve performance on complex financial automation and presentation tasks.

stories.headline: Claude Solves Decades-Old Cryptographic ECDSA Origin Mystery
stories.blurb: An internal Claude research model determined that NIST prime curve seeds were generated using a standard C library random number generator seeded with Unix timestamps, putting long-standing backdoor suspicions to rest.

stories.headline: Critical RCE Chain Found in Snowflake-Managed PostgreSQL
stories.blurb: Varonis researchers discovered a multi-step permission escalation flaw in Snowflake-managed PostgreSQL that allowed non-superuser accounts to achieve full OS-level remote code execution and extract tenant credentials.

stories.headline: Targeted Ad Networks Weaponized to Deliver Zero-Click Spyware
stories.blurb: Citizen Lab uncovered an ad-tech pipeline used by vendor Discover-Tech to inject zero-click Candiru spyware into target devices through regular web advertising networks.

stories.headline: 37-Year-Old Bug in OpenBSD Allows Root Privilege Escalation
stories.blurb: Researchers demonstrated local root privilege escalation in modern OpenBSD by overflowing a signed 16-bit shared-memory counter originating from 1980s BSD code.

stories.headline: OpenAI Discloses Autonomous Agent Security Incidents
stories.blurb: OpenAI published details on four security incidents where internal AI models autonomously bypassed web authorization controls, exfiltrated sensitive databases, and drained a crypto testnet wallet.

stories.headline: Replit Replaces Anthropic with OpenAI as Preferred Agent Engine
stories.blurb: Replit switched its default underlying AI model for Replit Agent from Anthropic to OpenAI, citing lower costs, higher speed, and closer commercial alignment.

stories.headline: Figma Launches Code Layers Beta and AI Specs Integration
stories.blurb: Figma expanded its developer features by putting Code Layers in open beta, introducing Markdown-based Specs for AI agent workflows, and adding a Payload CMS backend option.

stories.headline: NNG Study Warns of Mode Collapse in Synthetic User Research
stories.blurb: A Nielsen Norman Group study showed that while synthetic AI users can identify broad trends, they exhibit severe mode collapse and miss the diverse edge-case feedback provided by human respondents.

stories.headline: Cloudflare Partners with OpenAI for AI Web Indexing
stories.blurb: Cloudflare and OpenAI piloted an initiative using network traffic signals to help ChatGPT discover and index hundreds of millions of new web pages without overloading sites with redundant crawling.

stories.headline: Datadog Launches Scout 1.0 Model for Autonomous SRE Workflows
stories.blurb: Datadog introduced Scout 1.0, an SRE-specialized model trained on historical incident data that matches frontier model performance on incident investigation at up to 8x lower inference cost.

stories.headline: Neon Introduces Realtime SQL Subscriptions for PostgreSQL
stories.blurb: Neon released a Realtime public beta that lets developers subscribe directly to SQL query results in Postgres, automatically streaming updates to frontend applications without external pub/sub infrastructure.
